This document details key actions required for the upcoming strategy period.

*   Update the borrower credit score for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize the interest rates quarterly.
*   Optimize the interest rates based on audit findings.
*   Monitor the interest rates quarterly.
*   Review the default risk for strategy 2026.
